description: Repair hull & armor at a docked station (heals up to 100 hull HP x ship tier per call (armor heals 75 % of that on top, own rate; execute_action REPAIR has the same cap), repeat until full; stops when funds run out). Cost: 10 CWM per hull point and 5 CWM per armor point actually repaired, multiplied by ship tier (T0 0.6, T1 1.2 up to T5 2.0) and the station repair multiplier. ARMOR_REPAIR_OPS/SHIP_REPAIR/BIOSCIENCE skill levels increase HP healed per CWM spent.
